ui_bugs.component: RadarChart — testid collision between Quality-radar and Image-radar
ui_bugs.issue: Both the Quality attributes · radar (Section 02, non-interactive) and Multi-dimensional Image Radar (Section 03, interactive via onAxisClick) generate identical data-testid pattern `be-radar-axis-{label}` from the shared RadarChart component in be-components.jsx line 111. On the dashboard there are 13 such testids — 3 from Quality radar (RELIABILITY, VALUE, DESIGN — NOT clickable) and 10 from Image radar (Trustworthy, Innovative, etc). Playwright selectors picking axes[0] or axes[1] land on the non-interactive Quality radar and the perceptual-map handler is never invoked. Impact: (a) automated testing brittle, (b) no evidence interactive click/perceptual-map flow works because correct axes were never exercised by my test script; (c) if a user clicks Quality radar axes expecting interaction, nothing happens (no visual cue that those axes are non-clickable).

The 4 perspective cards (AS ORGANIZATION / AS PERSON / AS SYMBOL / AS PRODUCT) render correctly with scores + 'aligned' tags, but the individual cards do not carry a data-testid like `be-association-card-as_organization`. Only the wrapping grid has the testid. Add per-card testids to make the tag (aligned/mixed/misaligned) targetable by tests and the review-request's criterion (cards showing score + tag) automatable.
Legend list is visually rendered (Mali · focal / Starbucks / Inthanin) but individual legend entries have no data-testid (e.g. `be-radar-legend-Mali`). Reduces testability.

critical_code_review_comments: brand_equity.py now 1243 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into models.py / templates.py / stats.py / ai.py / routes.py. Currently one file holds Pydantic models, template library, stats engine, AI helpers, and 12+ route handlers.

_generate_questions_from_template silently caps to top-2 competitors — good, but there's no warning/response-field telling the owner that their 3rd+ competitors aren't part of COMP-* / radar. Consider returning a `competitor_coverage: {included: [...], excluded: [...]}` hint in the study payload.
Template string replacement uses chained .replace(). A COMP question with competitor name containing '{' would break. Low-risk for brand names but worth using str.format_map with a default dict.

_aggregate_responses builds radar_axes_set ordered by first-sighting — focal brand axes listed first, then any competitor-only axes. For Starbucks+Inthanin sharing axes with focal brand, every axis label already overlaps so result is stable — but a future edit to COMP templates using a novel axis_label would get appended at the tail awkwardly. Consider defining a canonical RADAR_AXIS_ORDER list.

SectionIdentity in BrandEquityDashboardPage.jsx renders `be-image-radar` always once brand_axis is non-empty — good. The conditional pmAxes.length===2 correctly gates the perceptual-map card. No JSX-branching bug this round (unlike iteration_11). But the radar axes testids collide with Quality radar (see UI bug above).

rca of the issue: Radar testid collision RCA — RadarChart in be-components.jsx hardcodes `data-testid={`be-radar-axis-${axis}`}` without any namespace context. Both the Quality section (non-interactive) and the Image section (interactive) reuse the component. When Playwright queries all matching testids, the first matches are Quality's 3 axes (no onClick bound), so automated interaction tests silently no-op. Fix: parameterize the testid prefix per instance (`be-quality-radar-axis-*` vs `be-image-radar-axis-*`) and/or only attach the `be-radar-axis-` testid when onAxisClick is provided (so non-interactive radars emit something like `be-radar-axis-readonly-*`).
